manifest.name: byEar – Chord Finder & Audio to MIDI
manifest.description: Hear a song, see its chords. Live chords, notes and key for any audio in Chrome, exported as MIDI. Private, runs on your GPU.
manifest.action: byEar: see the chords of this tab
welcome.title: See the notes and chords in anything you play
welcome.intro: byEar listens to the music in a tab and writes out what each instrument plays: notes, chords and key. It all runs on your GPU, so no audio leaves your computer.
welcome.license: It uses the MuScriptor model by Kyutai and Mirelo, licensed {license}:
welcome.rule1: Personal and research use only, not commercial.
welcome.rule2: Only transcribe music you have the rights to.
welcome.size: One-time download of {mb} MB, kept in your browser.
token.title: Connect Hugging Face
token.intro: The token-free download isn't reachable right now. You can get the official model with a free Hugging Face account instead:
live.emptyListening: Notes show up here about 6 seconds after the music.
live.emptyIdle: Play music in this tab, then press listen.
live.emptyDev: Open an audio file to try it out.
note.hint: Click to hear it. Alt+↑/↓ changes the pitch, Delete removes it.
note.hintTab: Click to hear it. Alt+↑/↓ changes the pitch, ↑/↓ moves it to another string, Delete removes it.
key.tipLive: Estimated key of the last 45 seconds
key.tipFull: Estimated key of the whole recording
vocals.label: vocals
vocals.tip: The song has singing: listen for the vocal line too. Leave off for instrumentals.
view.label: View
insts.title: instruments
insts.muteTip: Mute: dim this part and silence it in MIDI playback
insts.soloTip: Solo: show and play only this part (Shift-click to add more)
dock.exportTip: download everything as a midi file
pill.title: Running on {gpu}. Click to change.
settings.fastDesc: Keeps up live on most GPUs. {mb} MB.
settings.accurateDesc: Catches more notes but needs a strong GPU. {mb} MB.
settings.instrumentsHint: Leave all unticked to detect any instrument.
settings.f32Desc: Slower, uses twice the GPU memory. Results are almost always identical.
settings.refineDesc: When you press stop, byEar listens to the whole recording again for a cleaner, more consistent result.
settings.tokenHint: (only needed if the free download is unavailable)
msg.cacheCleared: Deleted the downloaded models. The model downloads again the next time it loads.
msg.backfill: Filling in {n} × 5 s that were skipped while listening…
msg.cacheFailed: Couldn't save the model for next time, so it will download again: {error}
msg.refineFailed: Couldn't improve the transcription, so the live notes are kept.
err.noTab: There is no tab to listen to.
err.invoke: Chrome lets byEar listen to a tab only after you click its toolbar icon on that tab. Click the icon, then press listen again.
err.busy: This tab is already being captured, by byEar or another extension. Stop that first, then press listen.
err.badToken: Hugging Face rejected the token. Check it in settings, under Advanced.
err.noLicense: Your Hugging Face account hasn't accepted the MuScriptor license yet. Open the model page and click "Agree and access repository".
err.download: Download failed (HTTP {status}). Check your connection and try again.
err.noWebgpu: This browser can't use your GPU (WebGPU is off or unsupported). Update Chrome, or turn on WebGPU in chrome://flags.
err.gpuLost: The GPU stopped responding. Reopen the side panel to start again.
